section_heading: 4.9 PASSENGER BAGGAGE: ALL PORTS, 4.10 PASSENGERS' LEVY: ALL PORTS, 4.11 ADMINISTRATIVE FEES
plain_summary: This page details various fees related to passenger services and administrative tasks. Section 4.9 outlines fees for handling passenger baggage (excluding manifested baggage) for passenger-carrying vessels, charged per passenger upon embarkation or disembarkation. Section 4.10 introduces an additional passenger levy, applicable to all passengers embarking, disembarking, or visiting in transit, charged per passenger on a per-call basis. Section 4.11 covers administrative fees, including 4.11.1 Amending Fees for changes to marine orders post-invoicing due to customer requests, charged per request, and 4.11.2 Split Account Fees, charged per party, with the fee being levied once if processed PRIOR to vessel sailing and twice if processed AFTER vessel sailing.

calculation_relevant_numbers.context: Passenger Levy per visiting passenger in transit per call
Split Account Fee per party (PRIOR to vessel sailing)
Split Account Fee levied AFTER vessel sailing
